target.rawQuery:
WITH runs AS (
  SELECT run_id, min(time) AS time, max(aws_commit) AS aws_commit, max(core_commit) AS core_commit
  FROM "karpenterTesting"."perfResults"
  WHERE $__timeFilter
  AND provider = '${provider}' AND scenario = '${scenario}' AND phase = '${phase}'
  AND trigger IN (${trigger:sqlstring})
  GROUP BY run_id
), s AS (
  SELECT time, aws_commit, core_commit, lag(aws_commit) OVER (ORDER BY time) AS prev FROM runs
)
SELECT time, concat('aws ', prev, ' -> ', aws_commit, ' (core ', coalesce(core_commit, '?'), ')') AS text
FROM s
WHERE prev IS NOT NULL AND prev <> aws_commit
ORDER BY time

panels.title: ${metric}
panels.description:
Value (solid blue) vs the bound in force (dashed gray step) for one gated metric of the selected
provider/scenario/phase. Red point = a FAIL status; yellow point = WARN (passed with < 10% headroom). Violet
vertical lines = the AWS commit under test changed (annotation, toggle at the top). Record time = phase END (phase start = time - the total_time_seconds value).

Query notes:
- bin(time, $__interval_ms) (panel min interval 1h) folds several records in one bin (re-run attempts, or
  more than one sizes vector) into one point: the value and bound of the record with the LEAST headroom_pct
  (min_by), and the worst status in the bin. The sink has no repeat dimension, so the fold stays here.
- `gated` keeps only gated records (ungated metrics carry only value/gated/upper).

WITH b AS (
  SELECT bin(time, ${__interval_ms}ms) AS t,
    min_by(value, headroom_pct) AS value,
    min_by(bound, headroom_pct) AS bound,
    max(CASE status WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 2 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS worst
  FROM "karpenterTesting"."perfResults"
  WHERE $__timeFilter
  AND provider = '${provider}' AND scenario = '${scenario}' AND phase = '${phase}'
  AND trigger IN (${trigger:sqlstring})
    AND measure_name = '${metric}' AND gated
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT t AS time, value, bound,
  CASE WHEN worst = 2 THEN value END AS failed,
  CASE WHEN worst = 1 THEN value END AS warned
FROM b
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Latest run: every gate, tightest first
panels.description:
Every gate of the most recent record of each spec (scenario/phase/sizes) for the selected provider
and trigger(s), sorted by the sink's headroom_pct (tightest first; negative = past the bound). status is the
sink's: FAIL = passed=false, WARN = passed with headroom_pct < 10, PASS otherwise. A re-run attempt is later,
so it wins. run_id links to run_url. Ignores the scenario/phase/metric pickers on purpose: this is the
one-glance "did last night pass" view. Record time = phase END (phase start = time - the total_time_seconds value).

WITH g AS (
  SELECT time, scenario, phase, sizes, measure_name AS metric, value, bound, headroom_pct, status, tier,
    aws_commit, core_commit, run_id, run_url
  FROM "karpenterTesting"."perfResults"
  WHERE $__timeFilter AND provider = '${provider}' AND trigger IN (${trigger:sqlstring})
    AND gated
), l AS (
  SELECT scenario, phase, sizes, max(time) AS last FROM g GROUP BY scenario, phase, sizes
)
SELECT g.status, concat(g.scenario, '/', g.phase) AS spec, g.metric, g.value, g.bound,
  round(g.headroom_pct, 1) AS headroom_pct, g.tier, g.sizes, g.aws_commit, g.core_commit, g.run_id, g.time,
  g.run_url
FROM g JOIN l ON g.scenario = l.scenario AND g.phase = l.phase AND g.sizes = l.sizes AND g.time = l.last
ORDER BY headroom_pct ASC

panels.title: ${metric} by commit
panels.description:
Mean value per AWS provider commit (aws_commit), in the order commits first appeared. Bar color =
worst status of that commit's records (blue pass, yellow warn, red fail); the tooltip has min/max, the bound,
the least headroom and the record count. A step up between two adjacent bars names the regressing commit
range. A core bump without an AWS commit change shows in the annotation text (core_commit).

SELECT aws_commit,
  avg(value) AS value,
  min(value) AS min_value,
  max(value) AS max_value,
  max(bound) AS bound,
  min(headroom_pct) AS min_headroom_pct,
  count(*) AS points,
  max(CASE status WHEN 'FAIL' THEN 2 WHEN 'WARN' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS status
FROM "karpenterTesting"."perfResults"
WHERE $__timeFilter
  AND provider = '${provider}' AND scenario = '${scenario}' AND phase = '${phase}'
  AND trigger IN (${trigger:sqlstring})
  AND measure_name = '${metric}'
GROUP BY aws_commit
ORDER BY min(time)

panels.title: Run environment
panels.description:
Environment of each run of the selected lane, so a jump in the Gates row can be matched against
a k8s version, control-plane tier, controller resource or core module change. A new color band = a change.
Empty cp_tier = kind (no EKS control plane). Record time = phase END (phase start = time - the total_time_seconds value).

SELECT bin(time, ${__interval_ms}ms) AS time,
  max(k8s_version) AS k8s_version,
  max(cp_tier) AS cp_tier,
  max(controller_shape) AS controller_shape,
  max(core_commit) AS core_commit
FROM "karpenterTesting"."perfResults"
WHERE $__timeFilter
  AND provider = '${provider}' AND scenario = '${scenario}' AND phase = '${phase}'
  AND trigger IN (${trigger:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
